title: A Network owner sees the chapter roll-up report on the Reach page, like a Collective owner

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: SCAN-960 let a Network parent through the report policy (lib/collective/network-report-policy.ts), but the only place the report renders, the Reach settings page, still checked for collective or nonprofit_collective, so no Network owner could reach it. SCAN-960's probe grepped the policy file and passed. The page now gates on isChapterParentPlan (lib/collective/member-spaces.ts), the same predicate the chapter tools use.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/reach/page.tsx','utf8');if(!/isChapterParentPlan\\(space\\.plan\\)\\s*&&\\s*<Suspense/.test(p)){console.error('SCAN-999: the Reach page renders the chapter report only for Collective plans, so a Network owner never sees it');process.exit(1)}"
